title: Dalebrook Delight | Fire Pit + Bar & Game Room
description:
Welcome to your home away from home in East Nashville! This 4-bedroom, 3-bathroom (plus bonus room with separate entrance!) retreat is perfect for groups, families, or business travelers. Enjoy the large backyard with a fire pit, a bonus room with a bar, and easy access to everything Nashville has to offer!

The space
⭐ Dedicated Driveway Parking for 4 vehicles + Street Parking
⭐ 15 min Uber to Broadway & Nissan Stadium
⭐ Huge fenced backyard w/ fire pit & lounge area
⭐ Fast Fiber WiFi – Great for Work & Streaming
⭐ Spacious bonus room w/ wet bar & games
⭐ Fully stocked kitchen for home-cooked meals

Let Me Show You Around:
First Floor:
✔ Open living area with comfortable seating & Smart TV
✔ Modern kitchen stocked with essentials
✔ Backyard access with fire pit & seating
✔ Bonus Room: Queen Murphy bed, wet bar, separate entrance
✔ Full bathroom

Second Floor:
✔ Primary Suite: King bed
✔ Bedroom 2: Queen bed w/ ensuite bathroom
✔ Bedroom 3: Two full beds
✔ Bedroom 4: Queen bed
✔ Full bathroom

Guest access
You will be messaged a door code a day before check in.

Other things to note
The house is fully equipped with Fiber WiFi, 2 TVs with Netflix, Amazon Prime, Disney+, and HBO BYO-LogIn . We can work with your group for special requests to make your stay perfect.

We are equipped with 24/7 motion-activated Ring cam that captures audio and video, exclusively monitoring the front door and surveillance camera in backyard to ensure your safety while respecting your privacy indoors.
